verdict.rationale: Mercury Books is a double-entry accounting system with GL codes, and its Command assistant can help with "organizing your chart of accounts," which implies the chart of accounts can be edited. Class dimensions are documented only for transactions synced to QuickBooks or NetSuite through enriched integrations, not as a native Books feature. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of custom account types, sub-account hierarchy, native class or tag dimensions inside Books, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
